title: Derived tensor, pullback and direct-image comparisons for a scheme-isomorphism square
statement: Let X,Y,X',Y' be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of X,Y in a common morphism universe w and of X',Y' in a common independently chosen universe w'. Use the recorded tensors [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback] and direct images [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Let f:X\to Y, g:X'\to Y', e_X:X'\cong X, e_Y:Y'\cong Y satisfy g;e_Y=e_X;f. Let a:D(Y')\simeq D(Y), b:D(X')\simeq D(X) be supplied equivalences, together with natural isomorphisms Q;a \cong (e_Y)_*^{complex};Q and Q;b \cong (e_X)_*^{complex};Q. Here Q is complex localization and the complex functors apply underived module pushforward in every degree and to every differential. Then there are natural isomorphisms tensor_{Y'};a \cong (a\times a);tensor_Y, tensor_{X'};b \cong (b\times b);tensor_X, a;Lf^* \cong Lg^*;b, and Rg_*;a \cong b;Rf_*. There are no supplied adjunctions, tensor-pullback comparisons, coefficients, quasi-coherence assumptions, or projection-mate assertions.

proof.text: For each scheme isomorphism the recorded equivalence is induced by exact underived module pushforward and its inverse. The supplied localization factorization identifies any a or b in the statement with this localized equivalence by uniqueness of localization.

Underived isomorphism pushforward preserves tensor: on stalks restriction of scalars along an isomorphism of structure rings is an invertible tensor comparison. Its exact inverse tests acyclicity, and tensor comparisons identify tensoring an acyclic complex before and after pushforward, proving preservation of K-flatness. Compute the two derived tensors on K-flat resolutions and descend the underived comparisons and their inverses to obtain tau_a and tau_b, natural in both variables.

The commuting square of scheme maps identifies (eY)_*;f* with g*;(eX)_* on modules. On a K-flat resolution both composites in the third assertion compute that same composite, because exact isomorphism pushforward preserves K-flatness. The left-derived universal property extends this comparison to alpha, including the inverse and naturality.

Exact inverse equivalences preserve K-injectivity: the Hom complex from an acyclic complex is identified with the Hom complex from its exact inverse image. Compute direct images on K-injective resolutions. Direct-image composition and the commuting scheme square identify g_*;(eY)_* with (eX)_*;f_* before localization. The right-derived universal property and the supplied factorizations yield beta. Localization uniqueness allows the two independently chosen morphism universes, and the argument also applies to empty schemes and zero complexes.

theorem schemeIso_derived_functor_comparisons
    (X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y'.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X' ⟶ Y') (eX : X' ≅ X) (eY : Y' ≅ Y)
    (hcomm : g ≫ eY.hom = eX.hom ≫ f)
    (a : schemeDerivedCategory Y' ≌ schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (b : schemeDerivedCategory X' ≌ schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (ha : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ a.functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y'.toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward eY.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (hb : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ b.functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X'.toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward eX.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) :
    Nonempty (tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y') ⋙ a.functor ≅
      a.functor.prod a.functor ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y)) ∧
    Nonempty (tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X') ⋙ b.functor ≅
      b.functor.prod b.functor ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X)) ∧
    Nonempty (a.functor ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅ derivedPullback g ⋙ b.functor) ∧
    Nonempty (schemeDerivedDirectImage g ⋙ a.functor ≅
      b.functor ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
